title: Path B External Integration Runbook
claim: Externally controlled refuse-before-sign: a buyer pipeline that is not ours evaluates and can BLOCK payment before any Solana signer runs.
why_first: Distribution without an external refuse artifact is amplification of supply. Path B is the only missing proof. Founder posts wait until one attributable external artifact exists.
not_this_runbook: Pay decisions → https://intel.twzrd.xyz/v1/intel/preflight. This runbook installs enforcement; it does not authorize spend. Free preflight ≠ product. day0.gate_evals ≠ buyer refuse proof.
north_star: Success = one attributable external buyer refuse transcript (BLOCK with signer_invocation_count=0, payment_retry_count=0) under partner control — filed as twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1. Not free MCP hits. Not internal dogfood.

metric_semantics.primary_proof: External Path B artifact: partner-controlled buyer gate run that produces a refuse transcript (signer never called on BLOCK). Schema twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1.

not_primary.means: Facilitator settle-gate evaluations on intel (seller/settlement path). Often shadow; orthogonal to buyer beforePayment refuse.
not_primary.use_for: Ops context only. Do NOT treat a rise in gate_evals alone as Path B external adoption.

not_primary.means: Free preflight / readiness cards hit by external callers (advisory).
not_primary.use_for: Warm demand signal — convert to gate install, not a success metric.

not_primary.means: Paid trust / portable proof by external payers.
not_primary.use_for: Secondary conversion after Path B seats exist.
CI and readiness only — never counts as external Path B.

metric_semantics.day0_gate_evals_note: intel day0.gate_evals counts facilitator settle-gate activity, not buyer AutoGate refuse transcripts. Path B proof is the external artifact + lineage, full stop.

steps.title: Prep the seat (before screen-share)
steps.detail: Confirm partner is an external buyer-side operator (agent client, not our seller worker). Share runbook URL + cold cmd. Do not lead with storefront merch.
expected: No expectation of funded wallet for BLOCK proof
pitfalls: Starting with free MCP hits as the demo
Counting internal dogfood as their seat

steps.title: Cold-machine refuse proof (their shell)
steps.detail: Partner pastes cold install + refuse eval on a machine we do not control. Capture full stdout.
pitfalls: Running on a TWZRD laptop and calling it external

steps.title: Wire gate into their buyer pipeline
steps.detail: Install beforePayment / AutoGate on their real x402 client path (not only the bin script).
commands:
import { createTwzrdBeforePaymentHook } from "twzrd-x402-gate";
// beforePayment: createTwzrdBeforePaymentHook({ refuseWashFlagged: true })
expected: Hook runs after requirement selection, before signTransaction

steps.title: Run BLOCK + ALLOW evidence capture
steps.detail: Paired evidence: refuse fixture BLOCK (no signer) then one ALLOW path they trust.
expected: BLOCK transcript with zero signer invocations
ALLOW still completes once on known-good intent

steps.title: Confirm lineage + file artifact
steps.detail: File twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1 with partner codename, machine note, package version, transcripts, health snapshots. day0.gate_evals may not move — that is OK if artifact is solid.
expected: Not closed solely because day0.gate_evals incremented

steps.title: Lock next seat + founder-post gate
steps.detail: Next codename only after artifact filed. Founder post only after ≥1 external artifact.

evidence.title: Refuse before sign
evidence.capture: Full refuse eval stdout or gate evaluate() JSON for a forced BLOCK path (refuse fixture / known-bad merchant).
evidence.pass_if: signer_invocation_count=0 AND payment_retry_count=0 AND decision=BLOCK (or equivalent refuse action).
evidence.fail_if: Any signer call, any payment retry, or missing decision field.

evidence.title: Machine-readable reason
evidence.capture: decision.reason / code / rule id from gate output.
evidence.pass_if: Stable string or code a partner can grep in logs.
evidence.fail_if: Opaque HTML or no reason on BLOCK.

evidence.title: Happy path still pays
evidence.capture: One ALLOW evaluate() result on a known-good intent (sandbox or mainnet as agreed).
evidence.pass_if: decision=ALLOW and existing sign path proceeds once.
evidence.fail_if: ALLOW path broken or always-BLOCK false positive on good merchant.

evidence.title: Preflight logged
evidence.capture: Log line showing free preflight (ReadinessCard / preflight id) before evaluate completes.
evidence.pass_if: Preflight id or card hash present in session log for both paths.
evidence.fail_if: Gate runs without intel preflight when product requires it.

evidence.title: Attributable payer lineage
evidence.capture: Install seat id / partner codename / agent id + timestamp. Not a TWZRD-owned laptop alone.
evidence.pass_if: External operator identity is explicit; artifact marks external=true.
evidence.fail_if: Anonymous or internal-only run counted as external.

evidence.title: Health snapshot (context, not sole proof)
evidence.capture: Before/after /api/intel-health or /health day0: free_card_hits_external, gate_evals (settle-gate context), paid_trust_payer_external.
evidence.pass_if: Numbers recorded for context; Path B success still requires the external refuse artifact even if gate_evals is unchanged.
evidence.fail_if: Claiming Path B closed solely because day0.gate_evals moved, with no buyer refuse artifact.

partner_sequence.why_this_order: Highest trust / fastest to a clean refuse transcript.
partner_sequence.session_goal: Cold refuse + wire hook + file artifact
partner_sequence.do_not: Skip lineage; do not substitute internal dogfood

partner_sequence.session_goal: Repeat evidence checklist on their stack

partner_sequence.why_this_order: Locks sequence before broad outreach list.
partner_sequence.success: Sequence complete or explicit hold with reason
partner_sequence.do_not: Open 10-target blast before three seats attempted

artifact.title: Attributable external Path B artifact

health_after.note: Path B success does not require gate_evals to increment

artifact.publish_rule: Founder recap / announcement only after at least one external artifact exists. Enrollment-without-artifact is not the post. Do not claim success from day0.gate_evals alone.

minutes.say: We are installing refuse-before-sign — not another free API call.
minutes.show: Live Board Path B + north star

minutes.say: Your shell, your machine. Paste the cold cmd.
Wire the same decision into your real beforePayment path.
File the artifact. gate_evals may not move; the transcript is the proof.

funnel_instrumentation.where: Artifacts + Live Board dogfood notes — NOT day0.gate_evals alone
intel /health day0 — facilitator settle-gate; do not equate to buyer refuse
Secondary conversion — after Path B seats
